What is the difference between Monthly and Lifetime?
Both unlock everything in Premium. Monthly renews every month and you can cancel it anytime. Lifetime is paid once and never expires.
What happens to my trees if I stop Premium?
Nothing is lost. Your trees, photos, reminders and backups stay exactly as they are: only the Premium features stop and ads come back.
I changed phone. Do I have to pay again?
No. Install Family Tree with the same Google account and tap Restore purchases.
Is my family data sent anywhere?
No. Your trees are kept on your device and in the backup folder you choose. Buying Premium uploads nothing.
How do I cancel the monthly plan?
In Play Store, open Payments & subscriptions › Subscriptions, choose Family Tree and tap Cancel. Premium stays active until the end of the period already paid.
